set.tovw: Three 1904 accounts, none mentions hidden money; robbery presumed only
set.n: Woodchopper John Perkins' burned hut, 7 mi S of Niles (1904)
set.pl: Woods ~7 mi S of Niles near Granger (possibly the Indiana side); hut site not placed
set.st: Nov 1904: John R. Perkins, 60, who lived alone, was found under the charred ruins of his log hut 'in a lonely strip of woods about seven miles south of Niles'; the coroner ruled it an accidental fire. South Bend papers said he was murdered (shanty near Granger, body found 16 Nov), 'robbery regarded as the motive', and suspicion fell on a farm hand who bought cartridges at Frank Lowry's store in Granger and vanished; the case was left open. No paper mentions hidden money, an amount or a search. Pin is approximate, not the spot itself.
set.t: No cache claimed in any 1904 account; look-only history note.

src: Kalamazoo Gazette, 4 Dec 1904, p. 1 'Murder Theory Will Not Down' (Newspapers.com 1144808957)
